implementation.scope: Select a fixed extent for a nonzero flag or derive it from a 32-bit shifted count; preserve the final full-64-bit addition, scratch registers and CR6.

validation.tested_scope: Ordinary count, word-shift truncation, full-64-bit final addition beyond UINT32_MAX and nonzero high-bit flag; high-bit incoming base/GPR/SP/LR, selected GPR/CR/XER and unchanged ordinary RAM.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Other inputs, faults, MMIO, concurrency, unselected ABI and runtime behavior.
